cooked: The ASIC compatibility claim seems to need a distinction between matching an 80-byte header layout and being directly mineable by existing SHA256d ASICs. The hashed preimage also includes the prefix and suffix length commitments, and the script checks a double-SHA256 result. Can a standard miner vary the nonce while preserving that exact preimage format, or does this currently require a custom work generator even if the fields line up with a block header?
